Why do we use circuit symbols instead of pictures?
questions.a: Standard symbols make circuit diagrams simple, uniform and easy for anyone to read.

questions.q: Draw the symbols of a cell, a battery, a resistor and a switch.
questions.a: Cell: one long and one short parallel line; battery: two such pairs; resistor: zig-zag/rectangle; switch: a break in the line with a lever.

questions.q: What does an ammeter and a voltmeter measure and how are they connected?
questions.a: Ammeter measures current, connected in series; voltmeter measures potential difference, connected in parallel.
